text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is a racewear photoshoot. By chance, 
Sakura Bakushin O and Yukino Bijin ended 
up scheduled for the same day, and as I 
watched over them—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Abababa...! S-Smile, keep smiling...!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Y... Yes, yes, you're doing fine~! If you 
could just relax your shoulders a little 
more...!
choice_data_list: There's no need to be that nervous.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san! Look at me, a calm and 
composed honor student, and follow my 
lead! Good posture! Relax with a bright 
smile~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees! Stand sharp... and then, 
relax...! *huff*...! *puff*...!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: Umm... should we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~, this is bad... I have a photoshoot 
with Bakushin O-san after this too... 
Aaah, what am I supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even though you went through all the 
trouble of making me an outfit packed with 
all my favorite motifs...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, this outfit is jam-packed 
with all the pretty things I saw back 
home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The designer told me, 'Tell me what you 
like to help with the design!' And as we 
were talking, it just kind of happened..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san's hometown... is Morioka, 
right! I learned about it in geography 
class! When you think of Morioka, you 
think of snow! It snows there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. They made my outfit pure white, 
just like that snowy landscape...!‘

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
White like snow, a little fluffy... With 
an accent color of deep blue, like the 
snow's shadow...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And then, embroidery of little wild 
flowers...! The flowers that bloom in 
early spring from the melted snow are all 
so brave and hearty... and just so truly 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! I talked to my family on the 
phone too. My little sister suggested, 
"How about a snowflake bijou on the 
choker...?!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My dad was like, "Everything looks good on 
you, so just wear whatever you want and 
run like crazy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Yukino-san's father speaks great 
words of wisdom! Bakushin hard in clothes 
you love! I think that's the absolute best 
way too!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I've been thinkin' this for a while, 
but... My pops kinda looks a bit like 
Bakushin O-san, he does!"
choice_data_list: Ah, that look on your face...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Was I... smiling just now...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aha! I've got an ideaaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Bakushin-Style! Hometown Q&A!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees! If it's about Morioka, I can talk 
about it all day...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Question time! Any recommendations for 
spots around Morioka Station!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... it's the waterfall by the bus stop! 
There're lots of pigeons there too, it's 
so cute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next question! What's a delicious snack 
from Morioka!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Rice crackers! That's a surefire hit! They 
even got sweet, chewy nure-senbei too~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yubeshi, apple sweets, and so much 
more...! Morioka's got a whole heap of 
tasty treats! It's truly, honestly a 
wonderful place~!!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Looking good~! Keep it up! Let's keep 
building up the hype!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you both so very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm just glad I could help! I 
merely did what any Class Representative 
naturally would!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry for causin' you trouble... 
Thanks to you, I reckon we got photos my 
hometown can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry for causin' you trouble... 
Thanks to you, I reckon we got photos my 
hometown can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It was tough, but thinking about my 
hometown brought a smile back to my face!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! Thinking of your 
hometown makes you strong! And cheerful, 
Yukino-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! From now on, whenever I feel like 
givin' up, rememberin' that makes me feel 
like I can pull through...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree! Bright and dignified! 
It was a top-grade photo that captured 
Yukino-san's charm perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat! Y-You're praising me way too 
much! Getting complimented like that makes 
me so bashful~! E-... Eheheh...!
